films.release: 已确认引进中国内地，档期待公布
films.syn: 贝拉在生日聚会上割伤手指，库伦一家见血后的反应让爱德华决定离开福克斯。几个季节过去，贝拉和儿时伙伴雅各布一同修理摩托，才重新有了可以等待的东西。雅各布也开始隐瞒自己的变化。一场险情被误解为贝拉的死讯，她必须在爱德华向沃尔图里家族寻死前赶到意大利。
films.bio: 克里斯·韦兹与哥哥保罗共同执导《美国派》和《单亲插班生》，也拍过奇幻改编《黄金罗盘》。他在《新月》接手一个观众已经熟悉的三角关系，把爱德华的离开拍成需要在时间和空间里消化的失落。后来他参与编写《星球大战外传：侠盗一号》。
films.st:
罗森伯格继续改编原著。哈维尔·阿吉雷萨罗韦摄影，亚历山大·德斯普拉负责配乐。福克斯的室内压抑、保留地的树林与意大利广场的日光逐段改变画面的空间和颜色。故事里的沃尔图里家族居于沃尔泰拉，影片的意大利外景实际在蒙特普尔恰诺取景。

由亚历山德拉·帕察瓦斯参与统筹的歌曲原声将 Death Cab for Cutie、Thom Yorke 和 Bon Iver 等音乐人放在同一张唱片里，帮助影片把缺席和等待拍出持续的情绪。
films.editorial: 适合把这部当成一次失恋来看。贝拉坐在窗边，镜头绕过她，外面的月份已经换了几个，房间里几乎什么都没动。前半部愿意花时间拍这种停滞，后半部才让等待变成一场追赶。狼群借用了现实中的奎鲁特族名，片中超自然传说属于虚构设定。
highlights: 窗前的环绕镜头用同一个房间表现数月过去。
沃尔图里段落把故事从小镇秘密推向有制度的吸血鬼世界。
配乐和原声歌曲可以分开听，注意它们分别怎样表现停滞与行动。
honors: 获奖｜2010年 MTV 电影奖 · 最佳电影
films.contentNote: 涉及丧失后的孤立、自杀意图和高风险行为，也有幻想暴力。内地放映版本的具体尺度及闪烁等感官信息待核实。

films.release: 已确认引进中国内地，档期待公布
films.syn: 西雅图接连发生失踪和杀人案，一群新生吸血鬼被秘密组织起来。维多利亚准备借他们向库伦一家复仇，贝拉所在的福克斯也成为目标。库伦一家和雅各布的狼群只能暂时结盟。毕业将至，贝拉必须回答自己是否愿意为了走入爱德华的生活，放弃人的生命和时间。
films.bio: 大卫·斯雷德执导过封闭空间惊悚片《水果硬糖》，也拍过把吸血鬼作为围困威胁来处理的《三十极夜》。他在《月食》里安排并行的两条视线：一条看着贝拉毕业前的私人选择，另一条沿西雅图的街头袭击与福克斯的演练不断收紧。
films.st: 这一部继续由哈维尔·阿吉雷萨罗韦摄影，配乐改由霍华德·肖创作。布莱丝·达拉斯·霍华德接演维多利亚，泽维尔·塞缪尔饰演参与组织新生吸血鬼的莱利。罗莎莉和贾斯珀的往事用闪回带入故事，让库伦家族成员对人类生活与永生的态度逐渐显形。
films.editorial: 这部最适合对动作场面有兴趣的观众。也值得留意山间帐篷里没有打斗的一夜：爱德华和雅各布得先说清楚如何让贝拉活过今晚，才能继续争论明天。联手抵御袭击的情节，使两个阵营之间的边界突然有了可以谈判的余地。
highlights: 看西雅图的夜间袭击怎样与福克斯的毕业筹备交错。
罗莎莉和贾斯珀的闪回给贝拉的去留选择提供两个具体参照。
帐篷戏与集体战斗前后相接，私人关系会直接改变同盟的分工。
honors: 获奖｜2011年 MTV 电影奖 · 最佳电影
films.contentNote: 涉及幻想暴力、死亡和肢体损伤，人物往事涉及性暴力。内地放映版本的具体尺度及闪烁等感官信息待核实。

films.o: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn – Part 1
films.en: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn – Part 1
films.release: 已确认引进中国内地，档期待公布
films.syn: 贝拉与爱德华在亲友面前结婚，随后前往一座小岛度蜜月。贝拉意外怀孕，胎儿的生长速度很快威胁到她的生命。贝拉决定继续妊娠，库伦一家对该怎样保护她意见不一。狼群把这个孩子看作威胁，雅各布则要在族群的命令和对贝拉的承诺之间作选择。
films.bio: 比尔·康顿凭《众神与野兽》获奥斯卡最佳改编剧本奖，随后执导《金赛性学教授》《追梦女郎》。他在《破晓》上下两部连续执导，把婚礼的表演性、身体变化的恐怖和家族群戏放在同一部系列电影里，也让两个结局段落有连贯的视觉基调。
films.st: 原著最后一卷拆成上下两部，均由罗森伯格编剧、康顿执导，摄影指导是吉尔莫·纳瓦罗。两部连续拍摄，卡特·伯韦尔回归配乐。《破晓（上）》的空间先随着婚礼和蜜月打开，随后收缩到库伦家的室内。随着贝拉的身体逐渐衰弱，人物讨论她的选择时，观众同时能看见这个选择的代价。
films.editorial: 建议和下部相连观看。上部的戏剧重心放在婚礼之后，特别是家人各自以什么理由要求贝拉改变主意。电影前半部越讲究仪式和景观，后半段的身体恐怖就越突兀，这也是它最容易引起分歧的地方。
highlights: 婚礼、蜜月和室内疗护三个段落有明显的空间收缩。
雅各布与狼群的分裂，让他有了爱情三角之外的选择。
出生段落把系列带进身体恐怖，观影前可留意内容提示。
honors: 获奖｜2012年 MTV 电影奖 · 年度电影
films.contentNote: 涉及亲密场面、危险妊娠和分娩，部分画面血腥。内地放映版本的具体尺度及闪烁等感官信息待核实。

films.o: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn – Part 2
films.en: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn – Part 2
films.release: 已确认引进中国内地，档期待公布
films.syn: 转化为吸血鬼后，贝拉要学会控制新获得的感官与力量，也要保护成长速度异常的女儿蕾妮斯梅。有人误以为孩子是禁律所不容的永生幼童，向沃尔图里家族告发。库伦一家四处寻找愿意出面作证的同类，在雪地里等来了裁决者。
films.bio: 比尔·康顿在《追梦女郎》里处理庞大的表演阵容，到《破晓（下）》则要让来自不同地方的一组吸血鬼，各自在短时间内获得可辨认的立场和能力。与上部对照，康顿把镜头从围观贝拉的身体移到她如何观察、保护并回应这个世界。
films.st: 《破晓》两部连续制作，仍由罗森伯格编剧、吉尔莫·纳瓦罗摄影、卡特·伯韦尔配乐。片中引入多国吸血鬼证人，演员包括李·佩斯与拉米·马雷克。电影在保留原著关于禁律与举证的骨架上，重新设计了雪地对峙的叙述方式。阅读原作的人也可以把这部分留到影院再看。
films.editorial: 这是合适的系列收官场。留意雪地上谁先开口、谁只能在一旁等命令。召集证人的过程看似不断添人，实际上也把争端从两家人的冲突变成谁能解释规则、谁有权裁判的问题。尽量避开对最终对峙的详细剧透。
highlights: 贝拉转化后的感官和行动给系列换了一次叙述位置。
新登场的盟友把不同能力变为证词与对峙的资源。
片尾演员回顾把五部的不同阶段放回同一条时间线上。
honors: 获奖｜第33届金酸莓奖 · 最差影片
films.contentNote: 涉及儿童遭受威胁、幻想暴力及肢体损伤。内地放映版本的具体尺度及闪烁等感官信息待核实。

twilight-new-moon-2009.title: The Twilight Saga: New Moon
twilight-new-moon-2009.release: Confirmed for Mainland Chinese cinemas. Release date to be announced.
twilight-new-moon-2009.syn: After an accident at Bella’s birthday party, Edward leaves Forks. Bella finds some relief in rebuilding motorcycles with Jacob, whose own secret is coming to the surface. A misunderstanding sends her to Italy before Edward can ask the Volturi to end his life.
twilight-new-moon-2009.bio: Chris Weitz co-directed American Pie and About a Boy before making The Golden Compass. Here he builds a fantasy sequel around the experience of someone being absent from an otherwise familiar world.
twilight-new-moon-2009.st: Javier Aguirresarobe photographed the film, and Alexandre Desplat composed the score. Montepulciano stands in for the story’s Volterra. The soundtrack also draws on Death Cab for Cutie, Thom Yorke and Bon Iver.
twilight-new-moon-2009.editorial: The film is at its most specific when Bella is sitting by her window and the months change around her. Give the early stretch time before the story turns into a race to reach Edward.
highlights: The circling camera measures several months from a single room.
The Volturi give the vampire world an institution and public rules.
Compare the role of Desplat’s score with that of the soundtrack songs.
twilight-new-moon-2009.contentNote: Depictions of isolation after loss, suicidal intent, risk-taking and fantasy violence. Sensory details and the Mainland release cut have yet to be verified.
honors: 获奖｜2010 MTV Movie Awards · Best Movie

twilight-eclipse-2010.title: The Twilight Saga: Eclipse
twilight-eclipse-2010.release: Confirmed for Mainland Chinese cinemas. Release date to be announced.
twilight-eclipse-2010.syn: A wave of killings in Seattle points to a newborn vampire army. The Cullens and Jacob’s pack strike an uneasy alliance, while graduation forces Bella to decide what a life with Edward would cost her.
twilight-eclipse-2010.bio: David Slade made Hard Candy and the vampire siege film 30 Days of Night. In Eclipse he keeps the romantic negotiations moving against a separate line of pursuit and preparation.
twilight-eclipse-2010.st: Javier Aguirresarobe returned as cinematographer, with Howard Shore taking over the score. Bryce Dallas Howard plays Victoria and Xavier Samuel plays Riley. Flashbacks give Rosalie and Jasper distinct reasons for how they understand immortality.
twilight-eclipse-2010.editorial: Come for the action and notice the night in the tent. Edward and Jacob have to get Bella through it before they can argue about anything else. The uneasy bargain gives the coming battle a human scale.
highlights: Track the cuts between Seattle’s night attacks and preparations in Forks.
Rosalie and Jasper offer different accounts of what becoming a vampire costs.
The tent scene changes who can protect whom in the battle that follows.
twilight-eclipse-2010.contentNote: Fantasy violence, death, bodily injury and accounts of sexual violence. Sensory details and the Mainland release cut have yet to be verified.
honors: 获奖｜2011 MTV Movie Awards · Best Movie

twilight-breaking-dawn-part-1-2011.title: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn – Part 1
twilight-breaking-dawn-part-1-2011.release: Confirmed for Mainland Chinese cinemas. Release date to be announced.
twilight-breaking-dawn-part-1-2011.syn: Bella and Edward marry, but their honeymoon ends when an unexpectedly rapid pregnancy puts Bella’s life in danger. The Cullens disagree over how to help her, and Jacob must decide where he stands when his pack sees the unborn child as a threat.
twilight-breaking-dawn-part-1-2011.bio: Bill Condon won an adapted screenplay Oscar for Gods and Monsters and directed Kinsey and Dreamgirls. He directs both parts of Breaking Dawn, following the series from a public wedding to the intimacy of a family crisis.
twilight-breaking-dawn-part-1-2011.st: The final novel was split into two films, shot back to back. Guillermo Navarro photographed them and Carter Burwell returned to score them. Part 1 moves from the wedding and honeymoon to increasingly confined interiors.
twilight-breaking-dawn-part-1-2011.editorial: See it alongside Part 2 if you can. The elaborate wedding and honeymoon give way to the most physically unsettling stretch of the series, in which several people claim to know what is best for Bella.
highlights: Watch the spaces close in from wedding to honeymoon to sickroom.
Jacob’s decision about his pack gives him a dilemma beyond the love triangle.
The childbirth sequence moves into body horror.
twilight-breaking-dawn-part-1-2011.contentNote: Intimacy, a dangerous pregnancy and childbirth, with some bloody images. Sensory details and the Mainland release cut have yet to be verified.
honors: 获奖｜2012 MTV Movie Awards · Movie of the Year

twilight-breaking-dawn-part-2-2012.title: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn – Part 2
twilight-breaking-dawn-part-2-2012.release: Confirmed for Mainland Chinese cinemas. Release date to be announced.
twilight-breaking-dawn-part-2-2012.syn: After becoming a vampire, Bella learns to manage her new senses and protect her rapidly growing daughter. The Volturi mistake Renesmee for a forbidden immortal child, so the Cullens gather witnesses to face them.
twilight-breaking-dawn-part-2-2012.bio: Bill Condon brings the ensemble experience of Dreamgirls to the large company of vampires assembled for the finale. Bella’s point of view also changes as she becomes able to act on what she sees.
twilight-breaking-dawn-part-2-2012.st: Shot back to back with Part 1, the concluding film retains screenwriter Melissa Rosenberg, cinematographer Guillermo Navarro and composer Carter Burwell. Lee Pace and Rami Malek are among the new witnesses. The film reworks how the confrontation in the snow is told.
twilight-breaking-dawn-part-2-2012.editorial: Pay attention to who gets to speak in the snow and who waits for orders. The witnesses turn a threat against one child into a dispute about who can interpret and enforce the law. Avoid accounts of the final confrontation before seeing the film.
highlights: Bella’s new senses alter the series’ point of view.
The witnesses bring distinct abilities and reasons to intervene.
The end credits revisit the cast across all five films.
twilight-breaking-dawn-part-2-2012.contentNote: Threats to a child, fantasy violence and dismemberment. Sensory details and the Mainland release cut have yet to be verified.
honors: 获奖｜33rd Golden Raspberry Awards · Worst Picture
